_provenance.row: the level-178 amulet named below, VERBATIM off the live projection
_provenance.template_id: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. A chain object id in a tracked file is what the chain-id gate exists to stop, so the consumer joins this row to a LIVING id read out of the seed manifest at test time — the same idiom content.test.js already uses. Nothing here reads the id as a chain fact.
_provenance.why: The STAT BLOCK is the capture that matters: biased on-chain item_stats::ItemStatistics pairs (32768 = neutral) under the chain field names /v1 serves them by. The client decodes them through chain/read_templates.decode_item_stat_ranges — the door pages/encyclopedia/item_corpus.ts runs every row through — and that decode RENAMES six of them to their UI spelling (raw_damage -> rawDamage, critical -> criticalHit, the four resistances). Pinned here so the simulator gear fold is exercised against the real wire AND the real key vocabulary, never a shape invented by the code under test (#1065).
